|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Once during your deploy phase, may place 1 card from hand face down under Hem. Your total battle destiny here is +1 for each card under Hem. If Hem lost or missing, place cards under-neath him in Used Pile. During your control phase, may place all cards underneath Hem in Used Pile.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Hem Dazon (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “During your deploy phase, may stack ‘salt’ (a card from hand) face down under Hem. Your total battle destiny here is +1 for each ‘salt’ card. During your control phase (or if Hem lost), may place all ‘salt’ cards in your Used Pile.” '''What changed:''' “Once during” → “During”; “place 1” → “stack ‘salt’ (a”; “hand” → “hand)”; “card under Hem. If Hem lost or missing, place cards under-neath him in Used Pile.” → “‘salt’ card.”; “phase,” → “phase (or if Hem lost),”; added “‘salt’”; removed “underneath Hem”; added “your”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 3, slip 35.
